page.layout: One column of Hebrew-Latin lexicon entries, each with a large Hebrew headword at the left margin; page number top right; Hebrew running head top centre. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: הָנַן [?] הַנִּינָה [?] Recta: Ezech.42.32. חָנוּן Rectum, Decens, Conveniens, Honestum, apud Rabbinos: Et in Targum, אתא מהנדנא Mulier honesta & conveniens, Genes.24.12. in Jonathane. הוֹן Decentia, Decus, Honestas, apud Rabbinos.

הֵדֵד [?] הַיְדִיד [?] Celeusma, Vox ovantium & se invicem hortantium, Jesa.16.9.10. לא ירדך היד Non calcabit (cum) celeusmate, Jer.48.33. Contracte juxta quosdam, ולא הד הרים Et non celeusmatis montium, Ezech.7.7. id est, Echûs.
הָרַד [?] Immisit, Injecit: Præter. ידו הדה Manum suam injiciet, Jesa.11.8. Ab.Efra putat esse pro ידה [?]. Chaldæus reddit אושיט Extendet.
הָדַךְ [?] Contrivit, Contudit: Imper. והרך רשעים Et contunde improbos, Job.40.7.
הָרַם [?] m. Scabellum: הרם לרגליך Scabellum pedibus tuis, Psal.110.1.

הֲרָם [?] Chald. Membrū, Fruftum: Plur. הדמין תתעבדון Frusta efficiemini, Dan.2.5. Sic Syrè, דנאבד חד הרמא Ut pereat unum membrum tuum, Matth.5. v.29. Verbum, הדם In membra, frusta concidere, Discindere, in Targum: והרמיה Ac discidit illum, Jud.14.6. sic Jud.19.29. והדימתה Ac discidi eam, Judic.20.6. כמא דמהדמין Sicut qui dilcindunt, Jud.14.6.
הָדַס [?] m. Myrtus; Neh.8.15. Plur. בין ההדסים Inter myrtos, Zach.1.8.
הָרַף [?] Deturbavit, Depulit, Expulit, Impulit: Præterit. הדפו Depulit eum, Numer.35.22. Futur. יהרפנו Depulerit eum, verf.20. cum Chatephkametz sub Daleth loco Scheva.
הָדַר [?] Honoravit, Honorem habuit, exhibuit: Præt. והדרת פני זקן Et honorem habebis faciei senis.

page.notes: Hebrew headwords and some Hebrew forms in the entries are printed in small or blurred type and are transcribed from my best reading; the vowel points in particular are uncertain and are marked [?]. The top running head (Hebrew letters) is only partly legible. The page number is read as 154 at top right. No marginal notes or catchword are visible.
